issue.title: Make source audio follow verses when verse timestamps are missing [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios G.18–G.20)

## Summary
Verse seek and the playing-verse highlight depend on the API's `verseTimestamps`. Without them, `verseStartMs` returns 0 (`src/hooks/sourceAudioHelpers.ts:53-69`) and the highlight poll is skipped (`src/hooks/useSourceAudio.ts:239-241`). Tapping a verse during playback then restarts the chapter, and the highlight stays on the selected verse. #235 notes DEV returning timestamps of `0`.

## Expected
Tapping a verse moves playback to that verse; the playing highlight follows playback (#48).

## Actual
G.18–G.20: playback does not follow verse taps and the highlight does not follow playback. No dev project with verse timestamps was found (no ticks on any waveform).

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open a chapter whose source audio has no verse timestamps.
2. Play, then tap verse 5.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] fluent-api returns verse timestamps for launch projects (source to be decided with product: DBL / Aquifer). Tracked in **[fluent-api#374](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/374)**.
- [ ] Without timestamps, the UI does not suggest verse-accurate seek (e.g. keep position instead of restarting; product to confirm).
- [ ] Unit tests for the no-timestamp path.
- [ ] Scroll the playing row into view when it goes off-screen (#48; no code reacts to `currentlyPlayingVerse` in `BibleTab.tsx`).
- [ ] Android device QA with and without timestamps.

## Related
- Spec: #48, #235, #408
- fluent-api: [#282](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/282) (source-audio route), **[#374](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/374)** (verseTimestamps population)
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #596 (source audio player)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)
